data.scope: Same exact task/reference/input-generator source; new case configuration only.

primary_criteria.screen: Same immutable per-task .02 quality allowance, nondecreasing aggregate quality per repeat, <=5% wall/solver overhead and original quality/cost benefit gates; complete independent full results.
primary_criteria.practical: Additionally >=10% relative quality gain with <=5% wall and token overhead, or >=10% wall saving at protected quality with <=5% token overhead. Both repeats protected; failed/incomplete usage prevents acceptance.
primary_criteria.uncertainty: Exhaustive paired bootstrap over4operator clusters,256draws. Fourcomparisons x2outcomes; alpha.05/8. No claim of8independent operators.
primary_criteria.cost: All acquisition/failed development costs retained; explicit incremental effects and total campaign resources, no hypothetical amortization claimed as observed ROI.

selection: Original exact-source/runtime/profile matching and same4original successful sources; compact prompt and both artifact arms use identical source. Linked view only changes duplicated measurement representation; full trace remains. No learner.
stop_rules: One frozen comparison, no model/job retries or resampling; preserve every failure/cost.
Missing complete final outcomes or model usage prevents acceptance.
Only a method passing original and practical/token conditions againstcontrol can enter newly reserved confirmation; artifact must additionally earn advantage over compact source.
Full-history artifact arm is a causal ablation; a failed ablation does not grant a representation-improvement claim.
Old c/d confirmation and older audit sets remain unused.
limitations: Same4known operator formulas on new shapes/strides/seeds, not unseen operators, families, hardware or production evidence
Initial and independent final full remain; artifact spends one of4action slots, leaving at most3model decisions
Content hashes are integrity checks; approved manifests/trusted adapters are not OS sandboxes
No proof of general recursive capability improvement or superiority to original reference algorithms
timeout_recovery: All arms use opt-in bounded decision timeout stop, retain only actual full incumbent, require independent final; failed calls/costs not erased and missing usage still prevents acceptance. Local model process will have115s hard timeout and zero retries.
study_relation: Materially new lossless decision representation, an explicit full-history ablation, and bounded failure recovery on fresh e/f cases. Original artifact experiment and reserved c/d confirmation closed, not rerun. No claim that changing timeouts or representation alone proves RSI.

prior_study.disposition: Rejected and closed; original c/d confirmation never launched.
